question: Which deductee names are shared by more than one distinct deductee GSTIN?
gold_sql: SELECT t.deductee_name FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t GROUP BY t.deductee_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.gstin_ded) > 1;

question: What is the total revised TDS amount (IGST + CGST + SGST) across all TDS amendments?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(a.iamt + a.camt + a.samt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa a;

question: What is the total change in TDS base amount introduced by amendments (revised minus original)?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(a.amt_ded - a.oamt_ded) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa a;

question: Which deductor has the highest total revised TDS (IGST + CGST + SGST) in amendments?
gold_sql: SELECT r.gstin FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 r JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa a ON a.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 GROUP BY r.gstin ORDER BY SUM(a.iamt + a.camt + a.samt) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many invoice-level TDS amendment rows are recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa_inv a;

question: What is the total TDS (IGST + CGST + SGST) withheld from deductees named 'MH Engineering Works'?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(t.iamt + t.camt + t.samt) AS v FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds t WHERE t.deductee_name = 'MH Engineering Works';

question: How many GSTR-7 returns were filed after 28 November 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 r WHERE TO_DATE(r.fil_dt, 'DD-MM-YYYY') > TO_DATE('28-11-2025', 'DD-MM-YYYY');

question: What is the trade name of the taxpayer holding a casual registration?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.iscasdl = 'Y';

question: Which taxpayers have a registration validity end date while still not cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.rgtodt IS NOT NULL AND d.canc_dt IS NULL;

question: Which cancelled taxpayer has a cancellation date different from its registration end date?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.canc_dt IS NOT NULL AND d.rgtodt IS NOT NULL AND d.canc_dt <> d.rgtodt;

question: Which registered taxpayers have never filed a GSTR-3B return?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r WHERE r.gstin = d.gstin);

question: Which registered taxpayers appear neither as GSTR-3B filers nor as consignors or consignees on any e-way bill?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r WHERE r.gstin = d.gstin) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb e WHERE e.frgstin = d.gstin OR e.togstin = d.gstin);

question: How many GSTR-3B returns were filed by taxpayers in each jurisdiction division?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division, COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d ON d.gstin = r.gstin JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd GROUP BY j.division;

question: Which jurisdiction division has the highest total outward taxable value across all GSTR-3B returns?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division FROM public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r JOIN common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d ON d.gstin = r.gstin JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details sd ON sd.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b = r.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details_osupdet o ON o.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details = sd.idtbl_gst_rtn_r3b_sup_details GROUP BY j.division ORDER BY SUM(o.txval) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the trade names of the taxpayers who filed a GSTR-3B return for June 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN public.tbl_gst_rtn_r3b r ON r.gstin = d.gstin WHERE r.ret_period = '062025' ORDER BY d.trdnm;

question: How many taxpayers registered under STATE approving authority have a cancelled registration?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.appr_auth = 'STATE' AND d.canc_dt IS NOT NULL;

question: Which jurisdiction division does the taxpayer Mehsana Agro Traders belong to?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd WHERE d.trdnm ILIKE '%Mehsana Agro Traders%';

question: Which jurisdiction divisions contain more than one cancelled taxpayer?
gold_sql: SELECT j.division FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd WHERE d.canc_dt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY j.division HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question: Which jurisdiction range has the most registered taxpayers?
gold_sql: SELECT j."range" FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN common.mst_state_jurisdiction_code j ON j.state_jur_code = d.stjd GROUP BY j."range" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the trade name of the taxpayer whose GSTIN appears as consignor on the most e-way bills?
gold_sql: SELECT d.trdnm FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d JOIN public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb e ON e.frgstin = d.gstin GROUP BY d.trdnm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many registered taxpayers are casual dealers?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM common.t_all_delers_api_v_t d WHERE d.iscasdl = 'Y';

question: How many e-way bills have an assessable value above the average assessable value?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb e WHERE e.assval > (SELECT AVG(assval) FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb);

question: Which consignee names received more than 2 e-way bills?
gold_sql: SELECT e.toname FROM public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb e GROUP BY e.toname HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
